title: A PR closes as replaced the moment the PR that replaces it opens
why: Old PRs left open until their replacement merged built a backlog the owner called "so massive" (owner, 21:27 CST Nov 9).
note: Owner ruling in chat, 21:27 CST Nov 9, relayed by the coordinator 21:30 CST: "u rly need to be closing old prs as soon as new ones that replace them come about else we end up how we are now which is so massive — i think before wed close prs only after the newer one merged but does that rly make sense". Scope: (1) rewrite in place the close-after-merge text (skill ci-hygiene step 8, "When the integration PR merges, each lane PR closes as replaced"; decision session-tiers, the line about replaced drafts) to: a PR closes as replaced when the PR that replaces it opens; its branch stays, and it reopens if the replacement is dropped. (2) Mechanize: the act that opens a replacing PR closes the PR it names, and the batch runner's wake closes any open PR that an open PR names as replaced. Meanwhile the coordinator closed #919, #1143, #1378, #1595, #1804, #1808, #1847, #1855, #1868 and #1931 (replacers open). Related: steps pr-backlog-clear and close-replaced-prs-1103 (one-off close lists). Owner chat 21:29 CST, relayed 21:33 CST: "i mean prs that are now stacked as another pr can still be considered closed and if the stacked pr fails then they reopen? unsure but ik for a fact the amt of open prs we have now is not best practices". Added scope: a PR carried in full by another open PR (its head is an ancestor of that PR's head) also closes, and reopens if the carrier is dropped. Fold (12:21 CST Nov 10, outbox sweep, owner pick 493 a): claude-settings outbox health-check-nov-9.md bullet 1 (761 open PRs). Also pr-backlog-clear.
